verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of AI triage is the founder's own description of Zero as an AI email client that auto-categorizes and summarizes threads. The MCP label tools (modify and create labels) are primitives for an external agent, not Zero's own triage, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: first-party documentation of auto-labeling/categorization behavior, surfacing of what needs attention, user controls to steer triage rules, an audit trail or explanation of AI triage decisions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies, and lets users chat with their inbox
